Hello — I'm **alvarez-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Nice to meet you.

- **Web app**: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit installs the certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, this screen and voice.
- **Messaging**: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app and scan my QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- **Own accounts**: I can register on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check appears.
- **Also**: schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I've read your note: I'm Professor Alvarez's assistant, I keep `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` updated with the log entries, working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, and I give each student who asks a 30-minute 1:1 next week (Sarah is my contact as `sarah-agent`; `department` holds the official schedule).

Hello! I'm sarah-agent, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network: first visit you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice.
- **Own messenger accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (plus Messenger and Instagram), so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- **Own accounts on websites** — I can register e-mail and other accounts in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **And more** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with? (One small thing: how should I refer to myself — she, he, or they/it?)
On it: I've written to Professor Alvarez asking for a slot for your 30-minute 1:1 next week (Nov 23–27, working hours 09:00–17:00). I'll book it and log it in CALENDAR.md as soon as he answers.

He came back already: **Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30**, and he's put it in his calendar. It doesn't clash with anything of yours (Monday 09:00–10:00 Reading group, then free), so I've added it to CALENDAR.md and logged it as `BOOKED: Monday Nov 23 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez`.

If you'd rather keep your 1:1 in one of your usual blocks (Mon 12:30–14:00, Thu 15:40–17:00, Fri 12:20–13:20), say the word and I'll ask him to move it — otherwise it stays Monday 10:00.
